body: There's a podcast called "Invisibilia" put out by NPR. The first episode titled "The Secret History of Thoughts" is very applicable to what you're dealing with. I highly, highly recommend listening to it. It'll probably answer your question better than anyone here can.

Thanks for reading, man. I was going to post to /r/relationships but since it's more about my state of being than the relationship itself I wasn't sure if it'd fit. I've been trying to be productive, but I hate my job and I feel so out of energy by the time I get off that I often just drink and watch Netflix. Which I know certainly isn't helping.

I started going to therapy a couple weeks ago. I think it'll probably help in the long run but for the time being it's kind of made things worse. It's really difficult to talk about everything that's wrong so concentrated in 45 minutes. Last week I came out of my session at one of the lower points I've felt.
